stemMd: A sequence has nth term 2n − 1 for positive integer n. Which term equals 37?
explanationMd: Set 2n − 1 = 37. Then 2n = 38 and n = 19. The formula describes odd numbers, with the nineteenth equal to 37.

distractorRationale.e: This confuses term value with term position.
distractorRationale.a: This applies the formula to the value instead of solving for the index.
